verdict.rationale: Gemini's own quickstart promises a first API call 'in under a minute', and official SDKs exist for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go and Java. That covers the 'zero to first call in minutes' core. No evidence item shows the quickstart itself contains runnable, copy-paste code tabs for each of those languages, so the 'runnable code in my language' part rests on inference from the SDK list. missing for 10: explicit evidence of runnable per-language quickstart snippets (including REST/curl), documentation of the API-key setup step within the quickstart, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a first call really succeeds in minutes.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from zero to a first successful API call in minutes, with runnable code in my language

citations.quote: You'll make your first API call in under a minute
